description: strfry database-growth comparison on the original two Wok soak VMs
limitations: Accelerated replay omits long idle intervals and is not a second 24-hour soak.
Native strfry has MDB_NOMETASYNC enabled; strict cases clear it with a diagnostic interposer.
VM variability and separate native/strict phases prevent isolating the performance cost of the flag.
Different indexes, application behavior and LMDB versions remain; no language ranking or per-index attribution.
Proc write_bytes includes warm-up and is not physical flash write amplification.
Exports prove event-set equality, not strfry secondary-index integrity.
